faq.q: What is it like to live in Sithonia, Halkidiki?
faq.a: Peaceful and close to nature. Summer brings visitors to the resorts, but much of the coast stays green and uncrowded. In winter the smaller villages are very quiet, so year-round residents often choose a larger village such as Nikiti or Neos Marmaras.

Generally, yes. Sithonia is less built-up than Kassandra, with fewer large resorts and more forest. The trade-off is a longer drive from Thessaloniki and fewer services in the smaller villages, especially outside the season. For many buyers, that calm is exactly the appeal, and the larger villages still keep basic services open.

faq.q: Can I buy land in Sithonia and build a house?
faq.a: Often, yes, but not on every plot. Forest areas, zoning, plot size and road access all affect what you can build. Ask a civil engineer to check the plot before you sign, and your lawyer to confirm the legal side.

faq.q: Which beaches in Sithonia are close to property for sale?
faq.a: Sithonia has beaches along both coasts, from long sandy bays to small rocky coves. Many of our listings are a short drive from a beach, and some are on the first line. Use the distance-to-sea filter to see how close each home is.

body:
Living in Sithonia

Sithonia suits buyers who want nature, quiet and the sea. The drive from Thessaloniki is longer than to Kassandra, and many smaller villages are very quiet outside the season, while the larger ones keep basic services open all year.

Sithonia villages at a glance

  • Nikiti, at the start of the peninsula, with a year-round community
  • Neos Marmaras on the west coast, the busiest resort
  • Vourvourou on the east coast, with small islands in a shallow bay
  • Sarti, facing Mount Athos
  • Agios Nikolaos, a traditional village near the east coast

Houses and apartments for sale in Sithonia

Holiday apartments and maisonettes are common in the resort villages, with houses on the hills above the sea. Filter by type and price to compare.

Land for sale in Sithonia

Sithonia has sea-view plots and olive groves. Forest and zoning rules apply in many areas, so have an engineer confirm what can be built before you buy.

Villas and seafront property in Sithonia

Villas above quiet coves and homes on the first line to the sea are among the most sought-after properties in Halkidiki. See our Sithonia villas and Sithonia seafront pages.

Sithonia or Kassandra?

Choose Sithonia for nature, privacy and clear coves. Choose Kassandra for a shorter drive, sandy beaches and more services. Many buyers view both before deciding.
